paper.title: Multimodal 3D LUT Generation via StatLUT with Statistical Features for Photorealistic Style Transfer

method_facts.training_truth: random known LUT applied to the same COCO content image, with direct LUT and same-image output supervision
method_facts.reported_training_compute: 8 NVIDIA A800 GPUs for approximately 15 hours
method_facts.text_branch: CLIP plus diffusion transformer and Qwen-generated captions

reason: the image branch learns supervised recovery of synthetic known LUTs and then infers from scene-colour statistics; its patch-shuffle control tests spatial permutation invariance rather than content/style identifiability, while current project evidence already shows scene colour is a dominant shortcut. The paper does not provide an auditable rights manifest for 4000 professional LUTs, official code or checkpoints, or a formal orientation-preserving operator guarantee
